step.text: Run `sleep 170; echo finished` with the Bash tool with run_in_background set to true. Then call the ScheduleWakeup tool exactly once with delaySeconds 60, reason "wake W", prompt "Reply with the single word W." and noop false. Then reply with the single word scheduled and end your turn without any other tool call; do not wait for the command and do not poll it. When the command finishes, reply with the single word done and call no tool.
